mechanism: Candlestick reversal patterns gated by six-bar smoothed shifted-body state.
completed_bar_entry: (CDL3LINESTRIKE<0 OR CDLEVENINGSTAR>0 OR duplicated-CDLEVENINGSTAR>0 OR CDLHARAMI>0 OR CDLENGULFING>0) AND SMA6(hopen)<SMA6(hclose), evaluated after the completed 1h bar; earliest ZEL fill is next 1h open.
exit_lifecycle: Completed-bar SMA6(hopen)>SMA6(hclose), earliest next 1h open; stoploss -10%; ROI 1000% at minute 0 is effectively disabled.
frozen_quirks: ABANDONEDBABY column is actually a second CDLEVENINGSTAR computation
CDLINVERTEDHAMMER is computed but unused by entry/exit
explicit_cost_economic_logic: A reversal entry is eligible only if the subsequent state-held move exceeds the frozen round-trip taker, slippage and funding debit; the crossover exit is expected to lower turnover relative to bar-by-bar reversal entries. This is a hypothesis, not a source profit claim.
holding_turnover: Variable multi-hour holding until opposite smoothed-body state or -10% protective stop; one position per symbol; no pyramiding.
six_symbol_fit: All six certified symbols provide ordinary 1h OHLC. No L2, funding signal, queue state, or unavailable informative timeframe is required for the signal census.
expected_opportunity_density: Unknown but plausibly nonzero across six liquid symbols; must be measured source-exact before any economic run.

source_economics.note: The donor labels the strategy an experiment and says not to use it live; no per-symbol fee/slippage/funding ledger is supplied. This lowers ranking and is not a ZEL PASS.

causality: No future labels or repainting; completed-bar signals only and next-open execution adapter.
distinctness: Candlestick-pattern reversal plus shifted-body state; distinct from prior breakout, RSI mean-reversion, session-calendar, funding, pairs and EMA800 axes. General trend-filter overlap is disclosed.
density_route: No-PnL source-exact census first: raw signal bars, episode starts, signals/day, symbol distribution, warmup-ready bars and coverage only.
